Canopy provides AI-driven remote monitoring and 'supervision' for unsupervised restaurant devices — self-checkout kiosks, POS terminals, smart lockers, and security systems — using automations and agentic AI to detect and resolve device issues around the clock.

Canopy's 2026 'Fast Food Fault Lines' report, surveying 500+ employees at chains including McDonald's, Chick-fil-A, Burger King and Domino's, found only 20% of kiosk users said devices worked every time (unchanged from 2025); a companion consumer survey found 94% of customers now factor technology into where they choose to eat, up from 80% in 2025. (Scope note: Survey findings are self-commissioned research used for marketing; useful as an industry data point but not independently peer-reviewed.)
